<!-- Adding a tool? Check each box. CONTRIBUTING.md has the details. -->

- [ ] The project is at least 3 months old and has at least 50 stars
- [ ] The demo renders in the README preview
- [ ] The entry has a tag (`Hosted API`, `GitHub Action`, `Self-host` or `Website`) and a one-sentence description
- [ ] This PR adds one tool, at the end of the category that fits best
